text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day,
while heading to training as usual...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Fufu, kufufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto was smiling.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-No, you've got it wrong!
This is, um—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Upon asking what happened... it turns out her entire laundry went wrong,
and the lining of her clothes ended up completely frayed."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-And so, it felt kinda stiff and scratchy, and it tickled so much~...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'll go buy a new one tomorrow,
so for today, um, please make do with this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so, if you can't concentrate, training might be difficult.
choice_data_list: I'm giving you the day off today, so go buy it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? N-No, but really,
running isn't a problem at all, so I'm fi—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Hehehehe!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I-I did it...!
Thank you so, so much...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Since you went out of your way to listen to my selfish wish, I'm... I'm gonna give it my all...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: —Fufu, kufufu!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, no! It just shows I'm getting distracted...!
I need to get... get fired up...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, Doto seems to be in quite high spirits!
I can't let myself fall behind! All right—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*... H-Hold on, let me take a break—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eek! I-It's so coarse and scratchy...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if something's troubling them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—And through all the chaos, Meisho Doto brilliantly managed to finish her training!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
—Phew, haah~ What a relief.
I'm finally getting used to it~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No, no...
It was my own clumsiness, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Besides, somehow, I feel like I've been strengthened
in all sorts of ways more than usual...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"All's well that ends well, I guess~...
Ehehe..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In any case, it seemed to have
contributed to Meisho Doto's growth!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... He-Heheheh!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm fine. If I just concentrate,
it shouldn't tickle at all, I'm sure of it...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: —Hyai!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ugh, ouch-ouch—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her concentration seems to be severely drained.
At this rate, she might end up injuring herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, I decided to let her rest today...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: B-But still~...
choice_data_list: We'll make up for it tomorrow

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
!
I-I see. That's, true...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Understoood~
I'm heading out to do the shopping now—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uuugh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, we went to buy new clothes, and by the next day, we were able to conduct training as usual.
